ai_summary_zh: 本場區包含4處鋪面道路與人行步道，總面積約941.4平方公尺，路面狀況良好。場區內植被茂密，共計35株都市喬木，平均胸徑(DBH)為32.2公分。此外，場區內設有18處擋土牆或建築牆面，總垂直面積為278.9平方公尺，且場區內無任何水域。
ai_summary_en: The site features 4 paved road and walkway sections covering 941.4 square meters in good condition. The urban tree stand consists of 35 trees with a mean DBH of 32.2 cm at 1.3m height. There are 18 retaining or building wall structures with a total vertical area of 278.9 square meters, and there are no water bodies present on site.
